reuse.why: Builds on getNextDate's existing occurrence lookup, but adds the daily-skip rule inline rather than as a shared predicate or inside the getDateWithSkippedWeekend path the other weekend-handling sites use.

duplication.why: The same weekend filter is applied twice in getNextDate (before and after the reverse fallback), and the daily-frequency check is an ad-hoc expression no other site can reuse.

placement.why: Weekend logic belongs in shared/schedules.ts, but it is embedded in getNextDate only.

scope.why: Touches only getNextDate and adds focused tests.

maintainability.why: The rule lives only in getNextDate while getUpcomingDates (server/schedules/app.ts) and schedule-template.ts keep moving daily weekend occurrences, and the magic take: 3 lookahead silently assumes a one-day interval.

one_place.where: Only getNextDate in shared/schedules.ts applies the daily skip; getUpcomingDates in server/schedules/app.ts and the getDateWithSkippedWeekend calls in server/budget/schedule-template.ts still apply the old move rule
